title: Solr Admin is reachable without signing in
summary: Solr Admin is an administrative interface.  Reachable without authentication, it is a direct path into the data or the server.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Solr Admin") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put the interface behind authentication and off the public internet.
